mapper.update: UPDATE mq_message SET status = 1, retry_count = 0, next_retry_time = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 60 SECOND) WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND status = 3
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mq_message WHERE status = 1 AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= NOW()) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mq_message WHERE status = 1 AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= NOW())

SELECT m.* FROM mq_message m WHERE m.status IN (2, 4) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `order` o WHERE o.order_source = 2 AND o.user_id = m.user_id AND o.activity_id = m.activity_id AND o.seckill_item_id = m.seckill_item_id ) ORDER BY m.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
